Question B-003-008-001.

Why the correct answer is right: Overvoltage protection must watch the regulator output because that is the voltage actually delivered to the radio load.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "At the output of the filter": The filter output can differ from the final regulated output, so sensing there could miss a regulator fault.
- sourceIndex 2: "At the input of the rectifier": The rectifier input is still AC from the transformer secondary and is far upstream of the protected DC output.
- sourceIndex 3: "At the input of the transformer": The transformer input is the mains side. It cannot verify the DC voltage being applied to equipment.
